scope: Remove unchecked entity downcasts from dx_iface::writeEntity and fail closed when the public eType does not identify the exact built-in payload type.

guardedWriterRoutes: POINT, LINE, THREEDLINE, RAY, XLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, SOLID, DXF_TRACE, E3DFACE, ELLIPSE, LWPOLYLINE and POLYLINE
DIMLINEAR, DIMALIGNED, DIMANGULAR, DIMANGULAR3P, DIMRADIAL, DIMDIAMETRIC, DIMORDINATE and DIMARC
compatibilityCases: DRW_DimLargeRadial remains admitted through the DIMRADIAL route because it is a supported modeled subtype with additional writer fields.
dx_ifaceImg remains admitted through the IMAGE route so its path and source-definition identity continue to reach the image writer.
All other typed routes require both the expected public eType and the exact built-in runtime class before accessing payload fields.
implementation.failureBehavior: Mismatched runtime type or tag refuses the entity through the existing raw-writer failure path before typed serialization; fileExport preserves an existing destination.

validationProfile.source: The new dispatch failure/retry selector uses locally constructed POINT and CIRCLE entities retained through dx_iface callbacks; it does not load a drawing fixture.
mismatches: DRW_Point tagged as LINE exercises a base-to-derived mismatch that previously reached an unchecked downcast.
DRW_Circle tagged as POINT exercises derived-to-base truncation within the POINT inheritance family.
assertions: Both mismatches are refused atomically and preserve pre-existing destination bytes.
Corrected tags permit a retry on the same adapter.
Readback retains the POINT coordinates and the CIRCLE subtype, center and radius.

validation.buildCommand: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests --parallel 4; cmake --build build-gcc --target dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dwg_fixture_tests --parallel 4
validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1 in ASCII and Binary DXF.
validation.regressionTestResult: PASS: 17/17 focused adapter, primitive, annotation, dimension, MLeader, cloud/light and subtype-dispatch tests.
validation.fixtureRegressionTestResult: PASS: 1/1 using only the existing repository DWG fixtures, including the LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION ASCII/Binary output/readback path.
validation.combinedRegressionResult: PASS: 18/18 after rebuilding both dwg2dxf and the root test adapter so all CLI and fixture checks used the modified dx_iface.cpp.
validation.rawCastAudit: No active static_cast<DRW_...>(e) remains in dx_iface::writeEntity; the only remaining matching text there is a disabled legacy comment.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

fixturePolicy: The new failure/retry control is generated locally. The supplementary fixture regression uses repository-owned samples; no DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.
limitations: This establishes adapter runtime-type safety and selected generated transport only; it does not qualify physical producer breadth, entity semantics, BLOCK graph closure, or native consumer behavior.
P8 remains open and no DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
